notes.title: Nick Beard Will Return as a Guest Character in Mega Knockdown
notes.content:
GREENVILLE, USA - FEBRUARY 9, 2022

Jerk Circle Media, in partnership with the Mega Memecast, is proud to announce the upcoming game Mega Knockdown, a unique turn-based 2D fighting game that will be featuring Nicholas F. Beard, star of Nick Beard: The Fedora of Destiny, in the role of the character [b]Nick Beardguy[/b]. 

Nick is excited about this opportunity, since it's "Not a (expletive) RPG Maker game."

More information about Mega Knockdown can be found here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492750/Mega_Knockdown/

notes.title: DLC, Crash fix, Discord
notes.content:
[b]New DLC:[/b] 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/872250/Nick_Beard_The_Fedora_of_Destiny__Literally_Nothing/][img]https://i.imgur.com/M64ABc9.png[/img][/url]

The Literally Nothing DLC will do [b]nothing[/b] to enhance your experience playing Nick Beard: the Fedora of Destiny. 

You may ask, "Hey, if this DLC doesn't do anything, how come Steam just downloaded another 40MB of content to my computer?" Well, you'll have to take that up with Dr. John Steam, CEO of Valve.

[b]Crash Fix[/b]
Some users were experiencing a 'black screen' crash on startup. If this is happening to you, go to Properties->Betas and opt into the 'crash_fix' beta branch. This fixed the problem by disabling the resolution scaling that happens at startup. If the window is now too small for you, you can go fullscreen with alt+enter.

[b]Discord[/b]
We now have a discord! DAE chat clients? https://discord.gg/qr8kqZV

[b]Nick Beard on Android[/b]
I'm just gonna keep plugging Nick Beard's [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jerkcircledev.Woo_MLady]Woo M'lady[/url] dating simulator until someone asks me to stop. It's free!

notes.title: Release + Achievements
notes.content:
[b]Release Trailer[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6WSueT46EVE

[b]Believe in yourself...[/b]

Hold onto your fedoras everyone, the game is live! And as of this morning's patch, we've added achievements. Are you brave enough to collect them all?

[b]Patch Changes[/b]
- Enabled 10 Steam Achievements
- Revealed all hidden achievements
- In battle 2F09, when Nick plays Shadow Sagan's skeleton like a xylophone, he strikes the same rib twice in succession, yet he produces two clearly different tones. I mean, what are we to believe, that this is a magic xylophone, or something? For this reason, the entire sequence was removed.

[b]More Nick Beard?[/b]
If you have an Android device, be sure to check out our free Nick Beard mobile game, [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jerkcircledev.Woo_MLady]Woo M'lady[/url].
